notes.title: Sizeable 1.6.7: Cloud saving & small changes to puzzles
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

After a long time, steam cloud saving has finaly been added to Sizeable! You should be able to just start from your old save file without losing any data, since a lot of the save game state had to be rewritten, we hope this won't cause any issues for any of you! If issues do arise tho, just let us know on discord or here on the steam community forum!

We also changed 3 things that weren't very clear in certain levels! We will hide these as spoilers so that people who haven't played these levels don't get spoiled! :D

- [spoiler]Sky Island: The Gang plank was changed to something that grabs the attention of the player.[/spoiler]
- [spoiler]Sizeable: Same thing as Sky Island.[/spoiler]
- [spoiler]Lantern City: The pipe most people missed is now hopefully easier to spot.[/spoiler]

Thank you all for the continued support and for playing Sizeable! :D Make sure to join our community discord for future updates about Swan Song or any giveaways (because we are getting really close to 100K units sold!)

Cheers,
Sander Ambroos & the Business Goose Team

notes.title: A Quick update about Sizeable's future!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Sander here!

Just wanted to make this quick post to give a bit of an update about the future of Sizeable, the final level pack, the promised prizes and our other projects! 

For anyone who is looking to talk to us more easily, see a few more updates or talk with our community, make sure to join our discord through this link: https://discord.com/invite/hyEhfENBQN


Sizeable's Future & the final level pack

Things have been a bit silent around Sizeable and the final level pack these past couple weeks/months! Were very busy with 2 other games we are co-creating (more about these down below)! We should have communicated this earlier, so sorry about that! But now, we can announce the winners of the diorama mode contest that will inspire the final level pack down below! One of these levels has already some development, but just to be clear: Don't expect the update to launch in July! Ce are currently aiming towards a august/september 2022 release because of the other projects! 

We also have received our Switch Dev kit! So after the final level pack is done & released; we will be working on a switch port (with MAYBE 1 or 2 extra levels that could be ported to PC, we are not sure yet)!

Here is a small spoiler of one the levels from the (currently unnamed) community inspired update! It's simply called Sizeable and will focus on all of my favorite levels from the game and how the interactions/puzzles from those levels can be used in new fun ways! Note that the level is far from finished!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37896245/f0fec2827210a5f9f18bdc0c71ccc8074e0816bc.png


The winners!

Next we would like to announce the winners of the community Diorama mode contest! Their prizes will be send out once the (unnamed) community update goes live! The atual products they will be receiving will be shown here in a future update aswel once we actually received them! The winners are not in a specific order, we loved them all equally! These are the levels that will be used as inspirations for the final level pack and they will ofcourse be mentioned in the end credits (and in some way in the level itself aswel)! Thank you to everyone who participated, we saw some great creations!

TITAN STRIKES - CHARMSIL
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2784229967

MIXED SCENE - LOKE.NORDESJO
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2752746480

UNNAMED - 大橘子
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2790566370
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2790566411

PACMAN - YETIFROOD (posted in the community discord, not on steam)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37896245/05a31430d936d54e0b36690dd1bc4b1d452a757d.png


Our other projects

Next to Sizeable we are currently working on a few other games aswel! Because we are only a team of 3, this means we really have to manage our time during our work hours! So that's the reason why sizeable got pushed back a little bit currently! 

Our first project that we are co-creating together with Ram Ram Games is "30 Birds"! You can check out the steam page here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1708770/30_Birds/

The second game we are co-creating together with CVS-Gaming is "Musical Chairs"! Check out the Indigo trailer here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wWDdzbGvv_0&ab_channel=CVS-Gaming

And last but not least, Beau and I have been working on a small boardgame called "Dino Dino" that will be published by Bannan Games!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37896245/5230a2f08d4e9aa47425dfa58c4e58c2ed51d82f.png


Conclusions

We hope everything is clearer now on what you should expect from us the coming weeks/months! We promise to be more transparent and give you more updates on progress in the future! Thanks again for all the support <3!

Cheers,
Sander Ambroos & The Business Goose Team

notes.title: Steam Awards Nominations: Help us out! + Exciting news for the last update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

The Autumn sale and Steam Awards Nominations have officially started! That's why we are reaching out to you guys! With your help we could get nominated for the "Sit back & Relax" category by the end of the Autumn Sale! 

We also really appreciate all the support this past year, so that's why we want to reveal the next update for Sizeable: Diorama mode! No, this will not be the final update/level pack that will be released, but it does tie in to the final level pack! We also just released community items for steam! This includes Trading Cards, Emoticons & Profile Backgrounds!

What is Diorama Mode?
So what is Diorama mode & how does it tie in to the last level pack? Well, in Diorama mode you gain access to every object, ground type, animal, ... in Sizeable and the tools to create your very own diorama! Note that this is not a level editor and that Diorama mode is purely meant for sitting back and having a relaxing time with the music in Sizeable while coming up with your own diorama ideas! it isn't a level editor or puzzle maker.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37896245/f2245bb109daec3d8827ae06977b125a640080bc.jpg

And that is where the last level pack comes in! We want to ask YOU, the Community, for ideas for the last level pack! As soon as creative mode launches in a couple of weeks we want you to create your own diorama ideas and share them with us on our discord or here on steam! If we spot a great looking Diorama, we will try to use it as an inspiration for the next level pack! The chosen diorama's will also win something cool (not just a free key for Sizeable)! We are very excited to see what everyone comes up with! More details on the Diorama contest very soon!

So how many updates/levels/... will Sizeable still get?
Sizeable will get a few more levels in addition to Diorama Mode, but to sum everything up very quickly:
- 1 more level pack of 4 levels
- 1 more secret level
- Diorama Mode
- 3 more holiday themed levels (Christmas, Easter & Summer or Valentine)

Thanks again for all the support, and please help us out by voting in the Steam Awards!  <3 <3

Cheers,
Sander Ambroos & The Business Goose Team

notes.title: Update 1.1: Wonders of the World!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Wonders of the World is now live! We hope you'll enjoy the new free levels, tortoises and achievements as much as the first time you played Sizeable! We have summed up every added feature and bug fix down below.

ADDED FEATURES

 Added 5 new levels in theme of the Wonders of the World level pack.
 Each of these levels comes with it's own tortoise to find.
 Added 2 new achievements
 Added Polish as a Language.


BUG FIXES & CHANGES

 Changed the sprout model in the Ant's View level to a closed flower.
 Changed the Golf Tubes so that they don't wiggle when they are at their largest size. This sometimes caused the golf ball to clip through the tube and fall out.
 Changed the Main Menu to better fit the update.
 Fixed some bugs that occured while testing the Wonders of the World Update
 Fixed an issue where the hammer in the Northpole level would not snap upright.
 Fixed an issue where the key would sometimes not collide witht he keyhole in the Halloween level.



This means we have hit our first major goal on the roadmap! The next 2 dots are both  question mark dots, so who knows what will be added in these? More Wonders of the World levels? More secret levels? Or something else? You will find out very VERY soon!

We are currently hard at work to get a MAC and Linux version in your hands aswel! Expect these to go live in a couple days/in a week or 2!

Make sure to join our discord aswel, the wommunity will vote on what the theme of the next level pack should be very soon! https://t.co/QQOobL4gdF?amp=1

notes.title: Secret, Bug Fixes, Spoilers & quality of life updates!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We hope you all enjoyed Sizeable so far! We are very gratefull for the very positive reviews the game has received so far, but we also heard your need for more content! That's why we are currently hard at work to add some more levels to Sizeable! In this first week of launch we encountered a few bugs that should now be fixed (let us know if you still encounter any of these or any new ones). We also added a new small secret and a new hidden achievement to the game, just to make the wait for the first bigger update feel a little less long! We are also working on bringing the game to MAC and Linux as fast as possible!

BUG FIXES

 Fixed an issue where the catapult rock sometimes doesn't bounce on a market stall.
 Fixed an issue where some people didn't get certain achievements (unlocking all levels, finding secrets,...).
 Fixed an issue where the easter eggs on Easter Island couldn't be resized or moved once they were broken.
 Fixed an issue where sometimes the camera would get blurry on starting a new level.
 Fixed an issue where the minecarts sometimes float in the mine level.


ADDED FEATURES

 Added a new small secret level + achievement (it isn't much, but we want to add some more in the future in between bigger updates).
 The mouse scrolling can now be toggled between 2 different speed settings (normal or slow).
 Resizing objects can now also be done with the S & G key (should make the game playable when you don't have a scroll wheel).
 Added the text "Delete Save" to the button in the options menu to avoid confusion.


LEVEL SPOILERS
And last but not least, we want to show you some WIP screenshots of some of the levels from Wonders of the World! We are working hard to get this update in your hands as quickly as possible! The levels down below are: Gizeh, Tower of Pisa and Stonehenge!
